import pytest
from rich.console import Console

def test_background_color_carries_over_on_soft_wrap() -> None:
    console = Console(file=io.StringIO(), width=20, soft_wrap=True)
    console.print("soft wrap is on", style="blue on white")
    console.print("still has background color from previous line")
    output = console.file.getvalue()
    assert output.splitlines()[1].startswith("\x1b[48;5;15m")  # Check if the background color carries over
